blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Asia’s top pole-vaulter EJ Obiena on Thursday discussed with Sen. Bam Aquino how to further strengthen support for Filipino athletes. In a meeting with Aquino at the Senate, Obiena cited the challenges that national athletes face when representing the country in international competitions. READ: EJ Obiena joins Senate hearing on Team Philippines’ Asian Games run During the visit, Aquino also presented Obiena with a copy of Senate Resolution No. 701, congratulating and commending the Filipino pole vaulter for winning the gold medal at the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
